## Summary

> 1–3 bullets explaining the change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (no behavior change for valid inputs)
- [ ] New feature (loader, figure, validation utility, ...)
- [ ] Coding-dictionary change (REQUIRES version bump + CHANGELOG entry)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / housekeeping

## Reproducibility checklist

- [ ] `pytest -v` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] No new dependency added without a strong rationale
- [ ] If outputs change: hashes in `config/expected_hashes.txt` updated
- [ ] If the dictionary changed: version bumped, CHANGELOG updated

## Anything else?
